header: How the figures on this page were collected
text: Nothing here comes from a live system. We take consumption and availability from our systems once a month and enter them by hand when the report is published. Opinions come from one survey a year. If a figure differs from the printed report, the report is correct.
note: Maintained by the controlling team. Corrections are made in place and listed in the annual report's changelog.

rows.title: Population
rows.text: Every supply contract active at year end.

rows.title: Method
rows.text: Consumption from the metering system, opinions from the September survey.
